CREATE TRIGGER CDN.Dostawy_DeleteOrphaned_TwrPartie ON CDN.Dostawy FOR DELETE AS SET NOCOUNT ON
-- obsługa kaskadowego kasowania wierszy z tabeli CDN.TwrPartie DELETE CDN.TwrPartie FROM CDN.TwrPartie join deleted on CDN.TwrPartie.Tpa_ID = deleted.Dst_TpaID WHERE TPa_WMS = 0 and not exists (select dst_gidnumer from cdn.dostawy where Dst_TPaId = CDN.TwrPartie.TpA_Id) and not exists (select int_tpaid from cdn.inwtwr where int_TPaId = CDN.twrpartie.TpA_Id) and not exists (select mae_tpaid from cdn.magelem where mae_TPaId = CDN.twrpartie.TpA_Id)
SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE TRIGGER [CDN].[MagElem_DeleteOrphaned_TwrPartie] ON [CDN].[MagElem] FOR DELETE AS SET NOCOUNT ON
-- obsługa kaskadowego kasowania wierszy z tabeli CDN.TwrPartie DELETE CDN.TwrPartie FROM CDN.TwrPartie join deleted on CDN.TwrPartie.Tpa_ID = deleted.MaE_TpaID WHERE TPa_WMS = 0 and not exists (select dst_gidnumer from cdn.dostawy where Dst_TPaId = CDN.TwrPartie.TpA_Id) and not exists (select int_tpaid from cdn.inwtwr where int_TPaId = CDN.twrpartie.TpA_Id) and not exists (select mae_tpaid from cdn.magelem where mae_TPaId = CDN.twrpartie.TpA_Id)
SET NOCOUNT OFF
